question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: lives

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Learn means to gain or acquire knowledge of or skill in something by study, experience, or being taught. (अध्ययन, अनुभव, या सिखाए जाने के द्वारा किसी चीज़ का ज्ञान या कौशल प्राप्त करना या प्राप्त करना)
 
• Lean means to incline, deviate, or bend from a vertical position. (लंबवत स्थिति से झुकना, विचलित होना या झुकना)
 
• Leave means to go away from someone or something that stays in the same place. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु से दूर जाना जो एक ही स्थान पर रहता हो)
 
• Live means making one's home in a particular place. (किसी विशेष स्थान पर अपना घर बनाना)
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "It" is mentioned previously for the Indian Mongoose as a subject pronoun.
 
• "**It**" denotes a third-person singular subject.
 
• In English, the** -s** is only added to regular verbs in the present tense when the subject of the verb is a third-person singular subject.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words, "lives" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete passage: *The Small Indian Mongoose, (1) with __its little round ears, is an __(2) agile __hunter and has a long snout-like face and short legs that have sharp claws. It __(3) has __brown or grey-grizzly fur and **__(4) lives __**in abandoned burrows or tunnels. (5) ______ the rat-like appearance, mongooses are not rodents.*
